description: Hong Kong bus and green minibus routes by number, and MTR lines by name or code, the same as typing one in the site's Nearby box: where each runs between, its operator, its first and last departures by day, and this site's page for it (every stop, fares, live arrivals). A number can be several routes (route 40 is Citybus, KMB and three minibus routes in different districts): all are returned, each with its ends. Special services (a supplementary or short-working run) are left out once they have no departure left today. For travelling somewhere, use plan_trip.

kind.description: Only buses, green minibuses or MTR lines

language.description: Language for place and line names: en, zh-HK (Traditional Chinese), zh-CN (Simplified), ja, ko

query.description: A route number or line: "40", "N21", "A21", "28M", "Island Line", "港島綫", "TWL"

name: search_routes

routes.description: Every route matching: a number names all operators' and districts' routes with it. Empty when none does

route.description: The route number ("40", "N21"), or the MTR line's name ("Island Line")

from_stop.description: The first stop, where these times are from

timetable.description: One direction's first and last departures by day (the page has both directions)

to.description: The other end (a circular route has one)

url.description: This site's page for the route: every stop, fares, both directions, live arrivals

title: Look up a Hong Kong bus route or MTR line
